detail: CD4C >>4 instead of >>2 so pad bits miss
pad 1/3 turn direction swapped with pad 2
state 1 arrival does not write state 0
state 2 heading acc uses sra 5 instead of 3
state 0x10 heading acc uses sra 3 instead of 5
state-3 Y step uses sra 3 instead of 4
returns current state instead of constant 1
